summary: Tested shift management features for ParKaro valet platform. All 14 backend API tests passed. All frontend UI tests passed. Features tested: admin toggle valet online/offline, valet request online, admin view/approve online requests, offline valets blocked from parking/retrieving (403), online valets can park/retrieve, admins not blocked by online check.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/auth/me returns is_online field
Backend: OTP verify returns is_online in user object
Backend: PUT /api/admin/valets/{valet_id}/toggle-online requires admin role (403 for valet)
Backend: Admin can toggle valet online/offline
Backend: Toggle returns 404 for non-existent valet
Backend: POST /api/valet/request-online requires valet role (403 for admin)
Backend: Valet can request to go online
Backend: GET /api/admin/online-requests requires admin role (403 for valet)
Backend: Admin can view pending online requests
Backend: POST /api/vehicles returns 403 for offline valet
Backend: POST /api/tickets/retrieve returns 403 for offline valet
Backend: POST /api/vehicles works for online valet
Backend: Admin can park vehicles regardless of online status
Backend: Approving online clears pending request
Frontend: Admin panel shows toggle-online-{id} switch for each valet
Frontend: Toggle switch changes valet online/offline status with toast notification
Frontend: Valet offline banner (valet-offline-banner) shows when valet is offline
Frontend: Request Online button (request-online-button) visible and clickable
Frontend: Toast 'Request sent to your manager' appears after clicking Request Online
Frontend: Admin panel shows online-requests-card with pending shift requests
Frontend: Approve button (approve-online-{id}) visible and clickable
Frontend: After approval, valet shows ONLINE badge and shift request card disappears
Frontend: Valet online badge (valet-online-badge) shows when valet is online
Frontend: Offline banner NOT visible when valet is online
seed_data_creation: Created test vehicles during backend testing with unique phone numbers and license plates
context_for_next_testing_agent: Shift management feature is fully working. Key data-testids: toggle-online-{id} (switch on valet card in admin panel), online-requests-card (shows pending shift requests), approve-online-{id} (approve button), valet-offline-banner (red banner when offline), request-online-button (button to request online), valet-online-badge (green badge when online). Flow: 1) Valets default to is_online=false, 2) Offline valets see red banner with Request Online button, 3) Clicking Request Online sends request to admin, 4) Admin sees shift request card with Approve button, 5) Clicking Approve toggles valet online and clears request, 6) Valet now sees green Online badge and can park/retrieve. Offline valets get 403 when trying to park/retrieve. Admins are NOT blocked by online check. Tips/payment data is MOCKED (Razorpay not configured).
